name: retrieval
note: Authored by the implementing agent by reading server/data/legal/raw/*/extracted.txt, not from memory of the law. Each question lists the chunk locators that answer it. A hit means one of the top 3 retrieved chunks has the same source and section and, when a clause number is given, that clause falls inside the chunk's clause range. `section: null` accepts any chunk of that source. Questions with set=main were used to tune chunking and fusion; set=heldout was looked at only once, for the final numbers. lang: en = English, hi = Devanagari Hindi, hinglish = Hindi in Latin script. The human reviewer should replace or extend these questions.
